data.long_meaning: Name derived from Old English 'west' meaning 'west' and 'leah' meaning 'meadow'. This name was used to refer to someone living near or from a western meadow. The name Westley carries the meaning “From the West Meadow” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Westley usually hope their child will grow to embody from the west meadow and live with faith, good character and purpose.
